scope: MEM-INDEX-96 v3 native UTF-8 binary subprocess stdout bytes and local o200k_base text tokens across six synthetic navigation/read scopes; no total model-token, cash, quality, CPU, latency or KV claim

implementation.procedure: Independent read of index/storage/CLI and inherited list/check paths; inspect canonical snapshot and full-envelope budget
implementation.acceptance: No changed default APIs, stale cursor bypass, partial entry, implicit acceptance, or destructive SQL

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare complete pagination with full list; independent small fixture and invalid cursor/project/query/update/budget/legacy tests
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact ordering, metadata and content hashes; all declared refusal cases reject; originals recalled exactly

data_integrity.procedure: Bind source, measurement script/config/environment and raw JSON; independently inspect all scenarios and counts
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing scenarios; commands/source hashes match; full and candidate byte arithmetic reproducible

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recalculate byte counts and fractions, page arithmetic and status totals
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Finite nonnegative integer byte counts; saving=(baseline-candidate)/baseline; index+one recall less than full long-body fixture; short/full-read controls reported without required savings

measurement_validity.procedure: Capture real subprocess stdout bytes with PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8; decode without universal newline conversion and count all bytes/native CRLF or LF; pinned tiktoken==0.12.0/o200k_base counts the identical string. Include every index page and required recall response; test exact full CLI max_chars boundary in real subprocess.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Exact count/sum consistency for bytes/tokens and complete text including native terminators; long index plus one needed recall smaller; short/full-read controls visible; no total model-token promotion. v1/v2 observations retained as superseded because they measured LF logical payload.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent rerun of measurement and independent oracle; focused ordinary and optimized-Python tests; final repository/reader regression
reproducibility.acceptance: All applicable semantic checks pass; same deterministic counts apart from temporary root-path lengths; limitations and any failures retained
